sal.basis: Kuwaiti pay is quoted monthly in KWD, tax-free (no personal income tax). Estimate, not checked against a 2026 guide in this run (search budget used up, page fetches blocked): Senior Financial Analyst / FP&A, ~8 yrs, Kuwait City, about KWD 1,200-1,800 a month for expats; Kuwaiti nationals at banks, KPC companies and listed groups earn more, about KWD 1,800-2,700 from the employer, before the state's national labour support allowance. f = 0.06 maps Noura's 26,000 SAR to KWD 1,560 (Abdullah's current pay) and the v5 band 34-41k SAR to KWD 2,040-2,460, the middle of the Kuwaiti-national range. At the currency rate alone (1 KWD = ~12.2 SAR) f would be 0.082; Kuwait pays less than Riyadh's top employers for this role, so f is lower. Keep f within 0.05-0.07 when a salary guide is checked.

sub.en: Your new employer transfers your residence through PAM. A move early in your contract can need your current employer's consent.
sub.ar: جهة العمل الجديدة تحوّل إقامتك عن طريق الهيئة العامة للقوى العاملة، والانتقال بدري في العقد ممكن يحتاج موافقة جهة عملك الحالية.

sub.en: Moving to a private employer needs a residence transfer, which is often restricted.
sub.ar: الانتقال لجهة عمل خاصة يحتاج تحويل إقامة، وغالباً عليه قيود.
sub.fr: Passer chez un employeur privé exige un transfert de résidence, souvent restreint.

rule.en: If you need a new work visa, we skip Kuwait jobs that only take candidates already in Kuwait with a transferable residence.

rule.fr: Si vous avez besoin d'un nouveau visa de travail, nous écartons les offres au Koweït réservées aux candidats déjà sur place avec une résidence transférable.

desc.en: Private employers must keep a minimum share of Kuwaiti staff, set by sector and highest in banking, and government jobs go to Kuwaitis first. Kuwaitis in the private sector also get a monthly state allowance on top of their salary. We only apply to roles marked Kuwaitis only if you are Kuwaiti.
desc.ar: الشركات الخاصة لازم تحافظ على نسبة محددة من الموظفين الكويتيين حسب القطاع، وأعلاها في البنوك، والوظائف الحكومية الأولوية فيها للكويتيين. والكويتي اللي يشتغل في القطاع الخاص ياخذ علاوة دعم عمالة شهرية من الدولة فوق راتبه. وما نقدّم على الوظائف المخصصة للكويتيين إلا إذا كنت كويتي الجنسية.
desc.fr: Les employeurs privés doivent maintenir une part minimale de salariés koweïtiens, fixée par secteur et la plus élevée dans la banque, et les emplois publics vont en priorité aux Koweïtiens. Les Koweïtiens du secteur privé reçoivent aussi une allocation mensuelle de l'État en plus de leur salaire. Nous ne postulons aux offres réservées aux Koweïtiens que si vous avez la nationalité koweïtienne.

sensitive.notes: Photo: common on Kuwaiti and Gulf CVs emailed to recruiters, but not needed on ATS portals; we offer it, never require it, and only send it where a form asks. Gender, date of birth and nationality are standard fields on Kuwaiti employer portals (KPC group, banks) and on Bayt and GulfTalent profiles. Nationality also drives Kuwaitization ('Kuwaitis only' adverts), residence-transfer handling and government hiring. Marital status appears on some Kuwaiti CVs and on government forms (allowances depend on it) but is not needed for matching, so we do not ask (conservative). The Civil ID number is collected by employers at offer stage, never by us. Labour Law 6/2010 bans pay discrimination on grounds such as sex, origin, language and religion, so we never filter on gender or age, only on work rights and Kuwaiti-only postings. From general knowledge; not re-verified in this run.

legal.law: No comprehensive data protection statute; CITRA Data Privacy Protection Regulation (Resolution No. 26 of 2024, replacing No. 42 of 2021) and Electronic Transactions Law No. 20 of 2014; consumer terms under Consumer Protection Law No. 39 of 2014

privacy.en: Your data is protected under Kuwait's data privacy rules (CITRA's Data Privacy Protection Regulation). We never share it without your consent.
privacy.ar: بياناتك محمية حسب لائحة حماية خصوصية البيانات في الكويت الصادرة عن هيئة الاتصالات وتقنية المعلومات، وما نشاركها بدون موافقتك.
privacy.fr: Vos données sont protégées par les règles koweïtiennes sur la vie privée (règlement de la CITRA sur la protection des données). Nous ne les partageons jamais sans votre accord.

bio.en: Financial Analyst with 8 years in Kuwait City. I lead IFRS reporting and budgeting on SAP across business units and own the monthly close for a 40-person function. I built the rolling forecasts and variance analysis that cut our reporting time by a third, and I prepare the group's quarterly disclosures for Boursa Kuwait. I am looking for a Senior Financial Analyst or FP&A role in Kuwait City, Ahmadi, or remote.
bio.ar: محلل مالي بخبرة 8 سنوات في الكويت. أقود تقارير IFRS والموازنة على SAP عبر وحدات الأعمال، وأملك الإقفال الشهري لإدارة من 40 موظفاً. بنيت التوقعات المتحركة وتحليل الانحرافات اللي قلّصت وقت التقارير بالثلث، وأجهّز الإفصاحات الربعية للمجموعة لبورصة الكويت. أبحث عن وظيفة محلل مالي أول أو تخطيط وتحليل مالي في مدينة الكويت أو الأحمدي أو عن بُعد.
bio.fr: Analyste financier avec 8 ans d'expérience à Koweït. Je pilote le reporting IFRS et le budget sous SAP pour plusieurs business units, et je suis responsable de la clôture mensuelle d'une fonction de 40 personnes. J'ai mis en place les prévisions glissantes et l'analyse des écarts qui ont réduit d'un tiers notre temps de reporting, et je prépare les publications trimestrielles du groupe pour Boursa Kuwait. Je recherche un poste d'analyste financier senior ou en FP&A à Koweït, à Al-Ahmadi ou en télétravail.

culture.notes: Work week Sunday to Thursday (Friday-Saturday weekend); copy should use Sun-Thu days for interviews and deadlines. Salaries are quoted monthly in KWD, tax-free, and paid monthly; expat offers often split basic pay and allowances (housing, transport). Kuwaitis in the private sector also receive the state's national labour support allowance on top of salary, which is a big reason many prefer private-sector offers that keep them registered. Notice: Labour Law 6/2010 (Art. 44) sets at least 3 months' notice for monthly-paid staff on indefinite contracts, so 90 days is the safe default; employers often waive part of it for a new hire. Ramadan working hours are capped at 36 a week in the private sector. CVs: 2 pages, English (Arabic for government and some semi-government roles), with a personal block: nationality ('Kuwaiti national' up front), residence status and whether it is transferable (Article 18) for expats, often date of birth and a photo. Cover letters are rarely required; portals ask screening questions instead. Many adverts say 'Kuwaitis only' or 'transferable residence only'. Government roles go through the Civil Service Commission's central employment system; private employers verify Kuwaitis' history through PIFSS and expats' through PAM. English is the working language in banks, oil and listed groups; Arabic matters in government. From general knowledge; see KW.sources.md for what still needs verifying.
